_help: (design §GO.7, queue 124, Claude Code; first guesses for Mike to tune) Smoking herbs and the pipe at the hub fire. Display only (the queue's rule): no stats, no gates, no doses, no preparation. A herb is never used up: carry a pinch and smoke it as often as you sit. Sit on a log bench by the hub fire (interact standing by one, within seat.reach_m of its middle); with a herb carried, interact packs the pipe, takes an ember from the hearth with the tongs and puffs; left and right pick which herb you carry before you light it. While the pipe burns its effects rise over onset_s, hold for peak_s and fall over fade_s as the bowl burns out; standing up (a move key or Esc) ends it with seat.stand_fade_s.
_help_seat: reach_m: how near a bench's middle you stand to sit on it, from beyond the fire's and the shaman's own reach (crawler.json areas.interact_reach_m: nearer, the button is the song's); eye_m: your eye above the ground seated; stand_fade_s: how long the effects take to fade when you stand. pose: seconds of each beat of lighting (pack the bowl, the ember brought with the tongs, the first puff).
_help_herbs: Each herb: name, realm_area (crawler.json areas key whose realm grows it: 'first' is the built desert; the stand-in realms are not built, so theirs grow nowhere yet), smoke (its smoke colour), leaf and flower (the plant's look), onset_s/peak_s/fade_s (seconds), effects (one or two, each 0..1 at the peak): sky_tint {color, strength} tints the sky part of the view; music_filter {cutoff_hz} muffles the music and ambience toward that low-pass cutoff; time_slow {scale} slows the feel of time to that share (Engine.time_scale, back to 1 when it ends). Mike asked for cannabis strains and other smoking plants (§GO.7.2): these three are traditional smoking herbs of their homelands as first guesses; strains can be added as more entries.
_help_plants: Where herbs grow (§GO.7.3): per_realm plants of each herb on its realm's floor, placed like the key cuttings (SongWeb.spots, apart from them); take a pinch by interacting within reach_m, the plant stays.
_help_grow: [NOT WIRED YET — design §GO.7.3] Bring a herb home and grow it at camp (the plant loop). FirePipe.can_plant() is the hook; nothing plants yet.
log_sit: You sit on the log by the fire.
log_light: You pack your pipe with {name} and light it with an ember from the hearth.
log_stand: You get up from the log.
